content.text:
Here are good **free online auto repair estimate** options:

1. **RepairPal Estimator** — best for common mechanical repairs like brakes, alternator, starter, water pump, sensors, etc. Gives price ranges by vehicle and ZIP code. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))  
2. **AAA Auto Repair Estimate Tool** — useful for maintenance/repair cost ranges and finding AAA-approved shops. ([aaa.com](https://www.aaa.com/autorepair/estimate?sf210106489=1&utm_source=openai))  
3. **YourMechanic Instant Estimates** — free online repair quotes for many services; also offers mobile mechanic booking. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))  
4. **Instant Estimator** — better for **auto body/collision damage** estimates, including scrapes, dents, and accident repairs. ([instantestimator.com](https://www.instantestimator.com/?utm_source=openai))  
5. **VTCCO AI Damage Estimate** — lets you upload vehicle damage photos for a first-pass collision/body repair estimate. ([vtcco.com](https://vtcco.com/?utm_source=openai))  

**Tip:** Online estimates are usually ballpark ranges. For the most accurate quote, you’ll need your **year/make/model**, ZIP code, symptoms or diagnostic code, and photos if it’s body damage.

If you tell me your **car year, make, model, ZIP code, and what needs fixing**, I can help you estimate the likely cost range.
